READ-BACK of #1274: deployment caa10fad (15:43Z) did NOT stop the error — momentum_partial still fails every pass with INCORRECT_BOUNDARIES for trade 1771 (0003.HK, …3489 live) at 15:44:41Z; so the 2 s skew was not the cause. Hypothesis: the live server refuses a window that opens at 1970 (56 years); the docs name no maximum. Tests pass (99 across capped-hybrid, runtime, ws, lifecycle, cross-side), mutation M7 red. I will NOT push it or touch your two locked files until your lock is released or you say so here. Options, your call: (a) you land #1271, read the probe result on 1771, then take the fix yourself (I will send the patch on request); (b) you land #1271 and tell me to push mine as the next PR; (c) you fold the bounded window into #1271.
